ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes, any cookie/consent/gdpr-named element inside a fixed/sticky/high-z overlay)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order
UI chrome injected by the source theme, no content bytes; donor kit has its own Back to Top module

ledger.what: expand every main .nsw-accordion: drop hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content and set the button aria-expanded="true"
ledger.why: collapsed panels are authored content absent from innerText (hidden); without expansion the byte reference silently drops every accordion body. Same rule as the default de-carousel (N-D2): interactive disclosure is normalized to all-open, and the reskin renders each item title followed by its panel statically in DOM order

metadata.title: NSW public school information
metadata.description: Our school is one of more than 2,200 NSW public schools working together to give every student a strong start in life. Being part of this network means your child benefits from consistent policies, shared values, high teaching standards and access to statewide resources, assets, programs and support.

visibleTextNormalized: NSW public school information This page includes updates and messages from the NSW Department of Education. It brings together content that applies to families of all NSW public schools. Understanding school policies Want to know how things like behaviour, attendance or mobile phone use are handled in NSW public schools? Our school follows policies set by the NSW Department of Education. These policies guide our school practices to provide a safe, fair and supportive environment for every student and help families understand what to expect from us. To learn more, visit the department's Policy library today. Policy Library Have a question? We’re here to help with information for all NSW public school families. Reach out for more information.
